notes: Telepathy in Claude Code lets opted-in sessions receive messages in the background and coordinate with other Kit sessions. Quiet waiting does not poll a model; handling messages uses the receiving session as usual.
Your session has a visible callsign, and Telepathy preferences stay consistent across onboarding, the Lantern and the web app.
A new Kit requires a confirmed data source, a connected surface and a responding model before setup can finish. Local imports can start becoming useful while the remaining conversations arrive.
New memories remain visible while topics are still being worked out. Onboarding controls fit more comfortably, and update text stays readable in dark mode.
The save card says “Kit is deciding what to save” while it waits. Activity reports failures clearly, and wake cards show consistent memory counts.
